notes: The tightened trigger metadata for support-tone-and-citation. The skill is created with only the six starter exclusions from support-tone-and-citation.md; trigger round 1 then misses 10 of the 40 cases. Replacing skill_metadata.test_triggers with this object (PATCH /skills/{id}, or Skill detail -> Edit -> Metadata JSON) gets round 2 to 40 of 40. should_trigger adds +8 to a match; should_not_trigger forces score 0. A phrase matches as a substring of the message ("refund" matches "refunds" and "refund-eligibility"), or when at least 80% of its words (every word of a one-word phrase) appear in the message, so keep phrases specific.
